verdict.rationale: Supabase documents first-party event-driven automation. Database Webhooks fire on table INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE events and send HTTP requests to any endpoint, including Edge Functions. Supabase Cron complements this with time-based jobs that run SQL or invoke Edge Functions, created via SQL or the Dashboard, and Queues add durable background-task delivery. Missing for 10: event sources beyond table changes (e.g., auth or storage events), webhook retry/delivery guarantees, an AI-native path for authoring these rules beyond generic SQL/migration tools, and independent hands-on corroboration.
